title: Agnes M NDE 5245
content: I immediately became aware that the end-stage of my labor was giving complications, however I was very relaxed and confident. When I separated from my body, I had a feeling of floating. I had a feeling of total blessedness, a very intense wellbeing. I was floating in surroundings, which were very luminous and soft, rising up towards a more intense luminosity. Then nothing more, I came round much later in the intensive care unit. The doctors brought me back after defibrillation and the transfusion of several units of blood.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body

elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning No more notion of time.

elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: A very great blessedness and the feeling of smiling.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will

elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I appreciate life much more and keep the ups-and-downs of daily life in proportion. I give a lot of importance to human relationships.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I appreciate life much more and keep the ups-and-downs of daily life in proportion. I give a lot of importance to human relationships. After the NDE
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Several years later, and not with my intimates but with patients who are dying, I think that it helped them.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I had just heard about them in the media.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real I think it was real for me in the light of what I felt.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real I think this is what happens when the spirit leaves the body.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I was not afraid of death before this, it was not a taboo subject, even less so now. I know it is difficult for those who remain behind, not for the one passing over.
